heading: Experience that connects design intent to physical work.

items.organization: Formula EV Racing · University of Alberta
items.text: Leads planning and integration for Formula UA27 low-voltage systems, coordinating power distribution, sensors, board-level hardware, safety interfaces, and vehicle packaging with mechanical and software teammates.

Developed engineering data workflows for corrosion monitoring, inspection planning, and asset lifecycle management across multi-facility operations. Work connected historical data, field context, operating decisions, and technical deliverables.

Built and quality-checked industrial control panels from drawings through assembly, wiring, software loading, and pre-delivery review. Worked in a production setting where safety, repeatability, documentation, and delivery mattered.
